title: Casa Alamo
subtitle: Contemporary architectural flow meeting a vibrant tropical landscape
description:
Alamo House — Corner Serenity
The elegance of a minimalist retreat bathed in tropical light

Alamo House is a spectacular corner residence located within the exclusive nautical community of Puerto Aventuras. Designed to prioritize both privacy and architectural flow, this estate sits on a generous 5,812 square foot lot, offering a rare sense of space and seclusion. 

The thoughtful architecture unfolds across two levels, embracing an open concept philosophy that celebrates natural light and seamless flow. The main level welcomes you with a sophisticated study, expansive living and dining areas that spill onto garden terraces, and a modern kitchen anchored by a generous island and walk-in pantry. The master suite serves as a private retreat with direct pool access, while the upper level houses two additional bedrooms, each with private terraces overlooking the lush gardens.

The outdoor sanctuary centers around a stunning 49-foot swimming pool, surrounded by meticulously landscaped gardens that provide natural privacy and shade. Covered terraces extend the living spaces outdoors, creating perfect settings for both intimate gatherings and grand entertaining. The property's corner positioning ensures maximum privacy while the mature tropical landscaping creates a sense of established elegance and natural beauty.

True luxury at Alamo House is defined by its seamless integration into the Puerto Aventuras lifestyle. The property includes a closed two-car garage, a separate laundry room, and a utility room with a full bathroom to ensure smooth operations. Every detail, from the corner location to the organic transition between the interiors and the landscape, has been curated to offer a living experience grounded in space and quiet elegance.
highlights: Abundant natural light throughout the residence
Large garden with mature tropical shade trees
Master bedroom conveniently located on ground floor
Private terraces for all upper-level bedrooms
Closed two-car garage and private storage
